title: MV I didn't think it would be THIS FECKING HARD to add basic steam achievements :)

posts.author: LUKElcs
posts.body:
I'm at my wits end.  I've been up and down multiple forums and nowhere is there a straight forward, up to date, and clear/concise tutorial or series of steps to adding Steam Achievements to your RPG Maker MV game.
PLEASE. FOR THE LOVE OF PETE, GOD, GABE, KADOKAWA, AND ALL THAT IS HOLY, UNHOLY, AND EVERYTHING IN-BETWEEN-
Just... if anyone has a confirmed way to do this, and can explain it clearly-
Thankyou
Seriously considered taking the plunge for this plugin too, but someone said somewhere on reddit back in 2020 that they couldn't get it to work :
http://www.yanfly.moe/wiki/Steamworks_MV_(Visustella)
Maybe they just missed something, but it seems like nowhere on the internet is there any review or confirmation that it actually works, so I'm not risking it yet.
The other forum I looked at a lot was this one :
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...-updated-nw-js-super-high-performance.132405/
Started to follow along, but I ran into multiple issues with not being able to find the requested files in the links provided, or even links in later comments, and all of the most recent comments are error complaints soooooooooo <.<

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
I don't know if this will help at all, but did you see this thread and the thread it links to?
Steam Achievements?
Hey  I would like to integrate steam achievements into my game.  I've looked for some tutorials online on how to do it and found some topics in written form from these forums.  However I always prefer to watch a video where every step is explained - I learn faster that way.  Does anyone know any...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
I know a few folks from this forum has successfully implemented Steam Achievements. Hopefully, someone can point you in the right direction.
